asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_5 (adult female, Asian, short black hair, light red tee shirt under a safari vest) shines a portable grid-light across a dark mudstone slab to emphasize a series of webbed, five-toed footprints.

visual_notes.ichnology: A distinct crawling trackway featuring semi-plantigrade rear footprints (pes) with five clear, slender digit impressions showing webbed outlines. The skin impressions between digits are subtly preserved as low-relief textures inside the sunken cavities.
visual_notes.ground: Flat, dark-grey abyssal shale floor mixed with jet-black organic debris and scattered ammonite shells.
